content.title: Reperfusion strategy recommendations (excerpt)

recommendations.recommendation: A PPCI strategy is recommended over fibrinolysis if the anticipated time from diagnosis to PCI is <120 min.
If timely PPCI (<120 min) cannot be performed in patients with a working diagnosis of STEMI, fibrinolytic therapy is recommended within 12 h of symptom onset in patients without contraindications.
recommendations.time_window: <120 min for PPCI; fibrinolysis within 12 h of symptom onset if PPCI not timely

recommendations.recommendation: Rescue PCI is recommended for failed fibrinolysis (i.e. ST‑segment resolution <50% within 60–90 min of fibrinolytic administration) or in the presence of haemodynamic or electrical instability, worsening ischaemia, or persistent chest pain.
recommendations.time_window: Assess ST‑segment resolution at 60–90 min after fibrinolytic administration

content.notes: Excerpt shows guideline recommendations and strength (I, A). No gene names or genetic tests are mentioned on the page.
